value.body: Supply chain associates help plan purchasing, inventory and deliveries so materials and goods are available when needed. They work in manufacturing, retail, e-commerce, FMCG and logistics companies, and the day involves tracking stock and orders, coordinating with vendors and warehouses, and updating reports.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA, B.Com or B.Tech; MBA in Operations for some roles

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, ERP systems (SAP and similar), warehouse management systems

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often join as operations, procurement or inventory executives in e-commerce, retail or manufacturing firms. Strong Excel and familiarity with an ERP system help; an MBA in operations is a common route to planning roles.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Excel and ERP data entry and reports

value.title: At a glance
items: Some roles involve shift work at warehouses or plants.
Common next steps: supply planner, procurement specialist, or logistics manager.
Roles vary widely: procurement, planning, warehousing and logistics are different jobs.
